name: ayal-doron-methodology-skills
description: Ayal Doron's 'unreplaceable' methodology as Claude Code skills: a challenge intake, the irreplaceable-anchor test (what am I / my business the best in the world at), and the four tools for inventing a new playing field — the almost-absurd goal, the extreme obstacle, the extreme persona, and the calculated-risk knockout — plus habit infrastructure to make it stick. Works for a person, a team, or a business.
